quarterly_data.signal: Q3 FY2026 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, quarter ended July 31, 2026): GAAP net income was $397 million, or $2.30 per share, compared with $191 million, or $1.10 per share, in the third quarter of 2025; non-GAAP net income was $531 million, or $3.07 per share, compared with $297 million, or $1.72 per share.
